title: High-performance machine-learning-based calibration of low-cost nitrogen dioxide sensor using environmental parameter differentials and global data scaling
summary: Neural-network calibration using environmental differentials and global scaling improves low-cost NO2 sensor measurements against reference monitoring data. The result is limited to the tested sensor/reference network and conditions; transfer to other settings was not established.
ai_technology: Neural-network calibration for low-cost NO2 sensors
